page.layout: One page of text, one column; heading at top; signature at foot left-centre; printed page number top right (handwritten-looking "16" is a stamp/ink, not transcribed as page number unless printed); digitiser credit bottom right, omitted.

main_text.head: ADMONITIO.
main_text.p: ADMONITUM velim meum lectorem, priusquam opus hoc Typographo traderetur, me, de toto operis consilio consuluisse plurimos eorum ad quos scribo, nec quemquam reperisse qui in summa rei, per mearum chartarum lectionem, non esset evictus demonstratione novae meae Rationis, atque firmiter non crederet, non solum illud esse Causae Jugulum quod figo, sed & toto caelo errare qui volunt ruinâ aut infallibilitatis, aut chimericae successionis in primatum & Monarchiam S. Petri, involvi ruinam totius systematis Papalis, quod constat ipso Papa, ejus imperio, missâ, Religione & Ecclesiâ Romana: unum tamen extitisse de omnibus qui- bus-

page.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word. Words with printed hyphens at line ends: tradere-tur, demonstratio-ne, fir-miter, pri-matum, Pa-pa, Reli-gione, qui-bus. The word "evictus" appears printed as "cvictus" with a damaged letter; read as evictus [?]. The catchword "bus-" is the hyphenated word beginning the next page, and the signature "A * 2" is the gathering mark. The bottom-right digitiser credit was omitted.
